title: Fourier coefficient of an affine subspace density
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $ br$'s field with two elements, and let $a$ and $b$ be vectors in that space. If $b$ is orthogonal to every vector in $H$ under the standard coordinate dot product, then the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of the uniform density on the affine subspace $a+H$ at $b$ is $1$.

$\gamma$ belongs to the orthogonal complement of $H$
